<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the signals in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are at 144.78, 132.00, 130.07 (two signals), and 127.80 (two signals). That gives a total of 6 distinct aromatic carbon signals, indicating six aromatic carbon atoms in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
